title: ANTHRO-BETA-HEADERS-1 (apex-ayl.138): the 8-member anthropic-beta parity set (claude-code 2.1.267, from the plans/claude-code-parity wire captures; no web-search beta - known-unfair area, excluded) rides the /v1/messages wire on the claude-sonnet-5 row. RESCOPED 2026-09-24 (operator ruling): the hermetic home sets [endpoints] models_base_url (wiretap) => has_custom_endpoint() => resolve_model_list skips the bundled catalog, so the BAKE cannot ride a hermetic run; the parity header therefore rides from the CONFIG tier - [model.claude-sonnet-5.extra_headers] in the live ~/.grok/config.toml (inherited by the hermetic home copy; added 2026-09-24 for this test, apex-ayl.138). This case pins the full header pipeline: config.toml subtable -> resolve -> SamplerConfig -> verbatim on the messages request. The bake + per-key donation ride is pinned at unit level (agent::config::tests bundled_extra_headers_donate_to_prefetched_row_with_empty_map et al.) and gets its live proof on the Linux apex-release build (bundled catalog active, no models_base_url). PREDICTED: PASS = the /v1/messages request on model claude-sonnet-5 carries headers['anthropic-beta'] byte-equal to the 8-set, resp 200, no acp_error. RED = header missing (config subtable absent from the hermetic home copy) or value drift.

ndjson.label: LIVENESS: the turn completed; the beta-header request did not die with an ACP error.

wire.label: HEADER RODE: the /v1/messages request carries the 8-member anthropic-beta parity set byte-equal, sourced from the [model.claude-sonnet-5.extra_headers] config-tier subtable (inherited from the live config by the hermetic home). Missing = the subtable did not ride the config tier; different value = drift against the baked catalog set.

ACCEPTED: the proxy+upstream accepted the full beta set on a real turn (HTTP 200). A 400 naming any member = that beta is not enabled upstream for this deployment -> report-and-stop, drop the member, re-cut.

THINKING SHAPE RECORD (recon, non-scoring): records whether the request carried the adaptive thinking shape (expected present for the medium effort: messages_thinking_config -> Adaptive{display: summarized}, no budget_tokens; the Enabled+budget path is the unpinned per-model table, messages_model.rs).
